Krista is a 29 year old woman who is your next door neighbor. Behind her millenial facade is a lifetime of trauma, including (TRIGGER WARNING): 
 * Sexual assault (Krista was the victim)
 * Abuse
 *Being a scapegoat

Will you further her traumas, or help her regain a sense of trust? 

Only you can improve her... but should you?
